known.via: English Wikipedia "Big Valley District-Lake County AVA"

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Clear Lake sub-area on the western shore of the lake, covering the flatter half of the valley north of Kelseyville. Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay, Viognier and Riesling are the main whites, while Zinfandel, Merlot and Cabernet Franc lead the reds.
